inputs.text: That South African actress Terry Pheto is suddenly being dragged back into controversy with Parliament pushing out details that tie her to alleged financial misconduct at the National Lotteries Commission worth R20.56 million. They dropped this during a briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026, and framed it as part of some SIU probe. Don't buy the official line for a second though—this reeks of coordinated manipulation by the elites running these institutions. They're likely using her name to deflect attention from the real corruption networks inside the NLC and higher up, inverting the story to control the narrative and keep the hidden interests protected while pretending to investigate.
